summary.text: Robert Quigley, an independent write-in candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Kentucky's 6th Congressional District to Zach Dembo, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
His campaign website listed policy headings on wages, health care, taxes, tariffs, immigration and the environment.
